question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned until maintainers choose that direction?
rationale: The feature is feasible in the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, adds config/default surface, creates persistent FTS index behavior, and overlaps with external plugin and reranker directions.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer to external plugin or ClawHub
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and document that advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank features should live in an external package.

options.title: Keep vector-only by design
options.body: Close the feature direction after documenting memory-lancedb as a vector backend while memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main ownership and prior issue-review signal for the memory-lancedb path.
